components.fidelityNotes: One genericized row mirroring the code FinanceRow API and its ActivityRow/BalanceRow/AssetRow wrappers. Title aligned is the only layout used across Home — final's nine rows (three Your money + six Activity); the legacy Centered variant (12:60) is retained solely to keep Home — funded truthful to current production and keeps its Code Connect mapping. Value tone is a variant dimension whose value text is bound to Home-token color variables, so tone is a component property rather than a per-instance fill override. Home — final follows 'money in is green' (comment 1938656305) using activity-presenter incoming/outgoing/self semantics: Received (113:1228, 113:1348) and Borrowed loan proceeds (113:1324) use Success; Sent (113:1251, outgoing), Swapped (113:1274, neutral), and Deposited to Savings (113:1301, a self move between the user's own accounts) stay Default. Design-only differences production adoption must reconcile: the title-aligned value layout and the Value context slot are not yet exposed in code; code maps valueTone success to primary and TransferActivityRow does not set valueTone (direction is carried by the mark), so green money-in values need a production change; Borrow Cash's 5.1% APY must reconcile with the variable-APR contract; the design fixture shows '+' on Swapped and Deposited, whereas the presenter's self direction has no sign.

Signed total-balance allocation bar (Borrow segment left of a zero axis, then Cash and Investments right). Production owner since #789; segment weights come from shared/balances/present.ts presentBreakdown over snapshot totals, and the Borrow segment and axis render only when debt is positive. #791 run 12: 91:927 is now the items=borrow+cash+investments variant of the set 293:5935, beside items=cash+investments (293:5925) and items=cash (293:5930), so Home states no longer detach it; the 91:927 mapping still reports 'already mapped'.

frames.fidelityNotes: The approved final Home design at 390x844, first in the Screens section, and the production Home layout since #789. Every Your money row (Cash, Investments, Borrow Cash) and every Activity row (six) is a single genericized FinanceRow instance (Layout=Title aligned) configured only through component properties, named semantically (Balance / …, Activity / …). Money-in Activity values (Received ×2, Borrowed) use Value tone=Success (color/market-gain); the rest use Default. Borrow Cash's value context reads 5.1% APR (Jesse decision on #789: loans quote APR, Cash stays APY). Rows are inset 32 px from the frame edge (16 px content + 16 px card padding), 326 px wide.

markAssets.note: Real, license-clean SVGs imported in place into the existing CurrencyMarkSlot variants (set 12:59, all variant IDs preserved). #789 adopted the same sources in production: Twemoji flags (CC-BY 4.0) in apps/web/public/currency-flags/ rendered inset in a neutral circle, cryptocurrency-icons USDC/BTC/ETH (CC0) in apps/web/public/asset-marks/, and lucide glyphs through GlyphMark; licenses and provenance are recorded beside each asset directory.
markAssets.shadcnCoverage: shadcn's default icon set is lucide (this repo already uses iconLibrary lucide with lucide-react). No single shadcn registry covers flags + fiat/crypto + stocks; the combination adopted in #789 is lucide (ISC) + Twemoji flags (CC-BY 4.0) + cryptocurrency-icons (CC0). Per-stock brand logos are trademark-encumbered and need a dedicated licensed source; the generic mark is the stock fallback for now.

residualDifferences: Home — final (92:922) is the production Home layout since #789; Home — funded (13:19) is now historical baseline evidence; v1 (65:503), v2 (81:700), and the explorations are superseded review history inside the 'History (superseded)' section (145:1638).

#789 changed the FinanceRow Value context default and every visible Borrow Cash value context from 5.1% APY to 5.1% APR in Home — final, FinanceRow — all variants (131:1285), and FinanceRow — usage reference (116:1154). Production formats rates with two decimals (5.10% APR, 4.20% APY) to match the Save and Borrow surfaces; Figma shows one decimal.

Production Activity values are token amounts (+25.00 USDC) and contexts are dates (Sep 22, 5:00 AM); Figma shows fiat values and 'Today · USDC'. Fiat Activity values need priced transfer data, which is new backend data and out of scope for #789.

Production loading rows render ShimmerRows (pulsing mark, no chevron); the Figma loading state (190:2962) matches with the static Kind=Shimmer mark and Show chevron off. Code skeletons and the shimmer mark use foreground at 10%, and the Figma loading frame binds its skeleton rectangles and shimmer mark to color/alpha/foreground-10.

Home has no red load-error UI. Balance read failures show a status icon in the header (HomeHeaderStatus) whose popover holds the message and a Reload icon button, or Open Account when no country is set. Activity read failures show a centered, muted line with a reload icon inside the Activity feed. The shared destructive Alert no longer renders on Home; the Activity page (/activity, density page) still uses it.

A failing summary row stays tappable (so Save, Invest, and Borrow remain reachable on a cold balances error) but hides its chevron until it has loaded, as Figma shows. A row whose value is known but partial (for example Borrow with partial coverage) renders its value in the muted tone and raises the same header status.
Home no longer links to the Balances (/balances) and Activity (/activity) panels; both stay reachable by URL. Removing or re-homing them is shell work for #686.

In a component set the text-property default is shared by every variant, so MoneyBreakdownItem definitions all read 'Cash', Button definitions both read 'Add money', and TabItem definitions both read 'Home'; every instance overrides the label. The variant grid differs by dot colour, fill, and icon.
The browser uses the system sans stack while Figma resolves SF Pro/Inter text styles; glyph metrics and rasterization differ slightly.
MoneyTicker and navigation transitions are static in Figma; Figma does not execute pagination, network, retry, focus, history, account switching, reduced motion, or wallet behavior.

Updating shared component definitions (marks, MoneyBreakdownItem borrow) also refreshes the superseded frames and the funded baseline, since they instance the same nodes; this is intended component behavior and does not change any frame structure. The FinanceRow Centered (legacy) variant preserves the funded baseline's amount alignment.
The rendered US flag mark uses twemoji artwork scaled uniformly; its intrinsic aspect is compact rather than a 1.9:1 physical flag, acceptable at the 32px mark scale.

Run 24 regrouped the Components section (11:767) under seven category headings and reordered Screens (11:768): Approved final, Current production baseline, then the nested 'History (superseded)' section (145:1638) with v1, v2, and the explorations. Pairwise bounding-box audits report zero overlaps among the Components top-level children, the Screens children, and the History children. Only positions, parents (history frames moved into the nested section), names of variant values, and descriptions changed; no node was deleted except the stray sample instance 64:522 and its label 64:521.

Borrow Cash's context copy was shortened to the Jesse-approved one-line 'Against your investments' in Home — final (113:1204) and the FinanceRow — usage reference (116:1179); it renders on one line at the 326 px Home row width. Superseded frames (v2 81:700, v1 65:503) retain their historical 'Borrow against your investments' copy.
